programme.title: Nikah Pada Pandangan Pertama
programme.desc: Sakit hati Titi terhadap mantan kekasihnya yang sudah berkhianat, Titi rela mencari cara untuk membuat mantannya cemburu. Sampai seuatu kebetulan ia bertemu seorang pria, menikah pada pandangan pertama. Apa mungkin pengenalan singkat mereka akan bertahan lama?

programme.title: Banu Pangeran Ikan
programme.desc: Hendra marah dan tak sengaja sebut Banu sebenarnya anak ikan. Kirana sedih dan kembali ke kerajaan Ikan, karena sang suami telah melanggar janji.

programme.title: Joe & Robot Kopi S1 E6
programme.desc: Clara dan lbu Joe berangkat bersama seorang petugas polisi menuju persembunyian Duo Kepo. Tapi saat tiba di lokasi, rumah terbengkalai itu sudah kosong, Polisi mempertanyakan informasi lokasi dari Clara. Rupanya Duo Kepo sudah mengetahui HP Joe yang mengirimkan pesan sos dan melakukan Evakuasi dengan menggunakan sebuah gerobak yang melewati Clara dan Polisi.

programme.title: Mencintaimu Sekali Lagi Arini

programme.title: Cinta Di balik Awan S1 E1
programme.desc: Razi, yang baru saja putus dengan Jessica, merasa tidak ada gunanya bekerja keras sebagai fotografer majalah. Di tengah gejolak batinnya, Razi bertemu Jane yang menawarkan pekerjaan sampingan sebagai paparazi. Akhirnya ia menerima tawaran tersebut, meskipun awalnya ingin mundur karena risikonya terlalu berbahaya. Razi kemudian pergi ke Yogyakarta bersama Jane. Awalnya, ia berniat membantu Jane menemui seorang dukun untuk melakukan sesuatu terhadap selingkuhan ayah Jane. Namun, tanpa diduga keduanya mengalami petualangan seru dan menegangkan saat disandera oleh sekte sesat Kerajaan Ilahi Kamilia di Gunung Kidul. Akibat kebersamaan dalam situasi penuh penderitaan itu, benih-benih cinta antara Razi dan Jane mulai tumbuh.

Rey yang tinggal di rumah sendirian merasa takut sampe akhirnya menyalakan semua lampu dan mengajak teman-temannya Iqbal, Ebet dan Dewi untuk datang ke rumahnya. Sebuah kejadian horor dialami Rey ketika membuat kopi di dapur.

programme.title: Twisted S1 E5
programme.desc: Sepasang kekasih bernama Jorge (Yudha Keling) dan Zahra (Pamela Bowie) yang baru pacaran dan masih lugu ingin camping bersama di luar kota, saat mau pergi orang tua Zahra berpesan agar jangan berduaan aja, pamali. Mereka mengaku kalau perginya bersama teman-teman, namun ternyata mereka berdua saja.

programme.desc: Bea (Ariell JKT48), seorang gadis yang berasal dari luar Jakarta dan sangat suka bernyanyi, sedang menjalani magang di sebuah perusahaan bakery milik tunangannya, Surya (Hamzah Bustomi). Sementara itu, atasan Bea, Redido (Emeraldy), mulai menarik perhatiannya.

programme.title: Cantik Ya Kamu S1 E2
programme.desc: Millie (Windy Apsari), seorang Q Grader sekaligus pemilik kedai kopi, merasa tertantang oleh Rendy (Wafda). Sebagai seorang model dan aktor, Rendy berkomentar bahwa kopi buatan Millie kurang memiliki rasa. Menurutmu, apa yang akan dilakukan Millie?

programme.title: Cantik Ya Kamu S1 E3
programme.desc: Langi (Tika Bravani), seorang tenaga penjual asuransi yang sukses, saat ini sedang hamil, yang membuatnya merasa tidak percaya diri—terutama ketika ia mencurigai bahwa suaminya, Beno (Emil Kusumo), berselingkuh dengan seorang wanita bernama Ayu.

programme.title: Buletin iNews Pagi

programme.title: Kiko
programme.desc: Kiko, seekor anak ikan mas koki yang sangat mandiri, walaupun ia anak tunggal. Kiko selalu riang dan memiliki empat sahabat baik yaitu Lola si ikan diskus, Ting Ting si kepiting, Patino si ikan patin dan Poli si ikan cupang. Di sisi lain, sosok antagonis, Karkus si ikan lele dan Pupus si belut, selalu membuat ricuh kehidupan Kiko.

programme.title: The 5 Billion Dollar Legacy

programme.title: The Eunuch

programme.title: My Rebellious Son
programme.desc: Seorang pejabat korup berusaha mencuri patung Buddha nan sangat berharga dari kuil untuk menyenangkan sekelompok orang dari Barat. Dokter Zhang dan putranya berhasil mengalahkan musuh dan menyelamatkan patung itu.

programme.title: Rear Entrance
programme.desc: Nyonya Xu melihat seorang gadis kecil bermain sendirian di pintu masuk dari jauh setiap hari. Ia dengan hangat mengasuh gadis itu, lalu mengadopsinya dari orang tuanya yang tak memedulikannya.

programme.title: Rear Entrance

programme.title: We Love Millionaires

programme.title: Two Con Men

programme.title: The Deadly Breaking Sword
programme.desc: Prajurit Tuan Chang Qing bertemu wanita penghibur Liu Yin Xi di sebuah kota kecil. Liu meminta Tuan untuk membunuh Guo Tian Sheng, yang dikenal sebagai 'Dokter Pembunuh', untuk membalas kematian tunangannya.

programme.title: The Scandalous Warlord
programme.desc: Jenderal Feng menguasai kota Shandong. Tentara dan warga sipil di sana menyambutnya tanpa mengetahui sifat kejam dan nafsunya yang menyeramkan.

programme.title: Judgement Of An Assassin
programme.desc: Sebuah klan jahat merencanakan perselisihan untuk mendominasi dunia seni bela diri. Pembunuh bertopeng mereka membantai klan-klan lain dan salah satu pembunuh ditangkap dan diadili di pengadilan antarklan.

programme.title: Fangs Of The Cobra
programme.desc: Film thriller nan unik ini sama sekali tidak seseram judulnya, berkisah tentang seekor ular gagah berani dan berbudi luhur yang merusak perangkap, melawan tikus pemakan bayi, dan bahkan mengalahkan sejumlah geng saingan.

programme.title: The Battle Wizard
programme.desc: Pangeran Dali yang bernama Tuan Yu memutuskan untuk meninggalkan istana demi mempelajari dunia seni bela diri. Lalu, ia bertemu dengan sesosok penyihir ular dan saudara tirinya yang misterius.

programme.title: Mr. Funnybone Strikes Again
programme.desc: Big Potato membuka sebuah klinik Tiongkok kuno, namun metode tradisionalnya ditolak oleh masyarakat Hong Kong modern yang skeptis. Ia meminta sahabatnya, Mr. Funnybone, untuk membantu menyelamatkan kliniknya.

programme.title: Return Of The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: Film sekuel ini bercerita tentang imigran Yeh Feng yang kabur dari penjara untuk tinggal bersama paman Wang Sha yang jahat. Namun, ternyata kekasihnya, Ai Ti, telah menikah dengan seorang pria yang kasar.

programme.title: Mad Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: Seorang mantan ahli kung fu gaya monyet yang dikalahkan oleh seorang penjahat kejam diyakinkan oleh murid mudanya untuk mengajarinya kung fu gaya monyet demi membalas rasa malunya.

programme.title: Hail The Judge

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey: Pandora's Box

Ketika seorang pembunuh berantai mulai menargetkan para ahli kung fu, ia bekerja sama dengan polisi dengan imbalan kebebasan. Pertarungan hidup dan mati pun terjadi dalam menghadapi sang pembunuh.

programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, putra dari pengusaha yang culun, mendapat kekecewaan usai mencari jodoh di Hawaii bersama temannya. Kemudian, secara tak sengaja mereka terjebak dalam sebuah pertukaran identitas yang kacau.

programme.title: The Grandmaster

Demi mendapatkan kembali hak mereka, Richard meminta bantuan mantan istrinya, Kate. Keduanya kemudian menjalankan misi berbahaya untuk mencuri kembali sebuah berlian berharga di Prancis yang menjadi simbol kekayaan sang pelaku. Dalam perjalanan penuh humor dan kejadian tak terduga, mereka tidak hanya berjuang mendapatkan kembali uang mereka, tetapi juga menemukan kembali perasaan yang pernah hilang.

programme.title: The Night Clerk
programme.desc: Bart Bromley, seorang petugas hotel shift malam yang berada dalam spektrum autisme, berusaha memahami interaksi sosial dengan mengamati perilaku manusia melalui kamera pengawas yang dipasangnya secara diam-diam. Kehidupannya berubah drastis ketika seorang tamu wanita ditemukan tewas saat ia bertugas, membuatnya menjadi pusat penyelidikan polisi. Bertekad membersihkan namanya, Bart melakukan penyelidikannya sendiri dan perlahan mengungkap jaringan kebohongan, motif tersembunyi, serta ancaman yang semakin membahayakan dirinya. The Night Clerk menghadirkan thriller kriminal penuh ketegangan yang memadukan misteri pembunuhan dengan drama psikologis.

programme.title: Northern Borders
programme.desc: Northern Borders' mengisahkan tentang Austen Kittredge yang berusia sepuluh tahun, yang dikirim oleh ayahnya untuk tinggal di pertanian kakek-neneknya di Vermont. Di sana, ia mengalami petualangan liar dan mengungkap rahasia keluarga yang telah lama terpendam. Ceritanya berlatar tahun 1956, dan Austen merasakan pertanian itu sebagai tempat yang penuh dengan orang-orang eksentrik, terutama kakek-neneknya yang keras kepala, yang pernikahan mereka yang penuh masalah dikenal sebagai Perang Empat Puluh Tahun. Awalnya merasa terjebak di rumah tangga yang retak ini, Austen muda berencana untuk segera pergi, tetapi akhirnya terdampar tanpa pilihan selain beradaptasi dan bertahan. Sebuah kisah pendewasaan yang lucu dan terkadang mengejutkan, 'Northern Borders' membangkitkan nuansa liar Vermont, keindahannya yang luar biasa, masa lalu yang kelam, dan aura pesona.

programme.desc: Meral (8) baru saja pindah ke sebuah kota baru. Ia berusaha mendapatkan teman di sekolah barunya sebelum perkemahan musim gugur sekolah dimulai, tetapi ternyata hal itu lebih sulit dari yang dibayangkannya. Di rumah, ia berteman dengan seekor tikus kecil yang tinggal di kamar barunya, yang ia beri nama Peepeep. Takut orang tuanya akan membunuh Peepeep saat ia pergi, Meral diam-diam membawanya ikut serta. Berkat tikus kecil itu, Meral mendapatkan beberapa teman baru yang tak terduga. Ketika seekor burung hantu menangkap tikus kecil tersebut, Meral menyalahkan teman-teman barunya. Baru setelah mereka bersama-sama pergi ke alam liar untuk mencari muntahan burung hantu yang berisi tulang-belulang Peepeep, Meral akhirnya memahami arti sebenarnya dari persahabatan. programme.desc: Naya Gadis muda pekerja keras yang cantik tersebut bekerja sehari-hari di peternakan telur dan menyuplai telur ke toko-toko. Nada ke ruangan Bayu dan malah melihat bayu selingkuh dengan temannya di rumah sakit. Ingin move on dan cepat melupakan Bayu, Nada mengajukan diri untuk di pindah tugasnya. programme.title: Inside The Mind Of A Con Artist - Frédéric Bourdin
programme.desc: Dijuluki "The Chameleon", Frédéric Bourdin adalah mantan penipu serial Prancis yang mengaku telah memalsukan setidaknya lima ratus identitas palsu, termasuk seorang anak laki-laki Texas yang hilang pada pertengahan tahun 90-an.

programme.title: Where is the Perfect Energy Source?
programme.desc: Bumi sedang mengalami "krisis energi." Sumber energi "sempurna" harus tak habis-habisnya namun tetap melindungi bumi dan iklim. Tapi di mana kita menemukannya?

programme.title: Can We Turn Poop Into Gold?
programme.desc: Hari ini kita bisa menghasilkan energi dari hampir tidak ada apa-apa. Apakah kita bisa membuang banyak potensi ke toilet? Mungkin "kotoran" kita lebih dari sekadar limbah yang tidak berguna?

programme.title: Inside The Mind Of A Con Artist - Shaun Greenhalgh
programme.desc: Mengikuti sebuah eksperimen unik di mana sekelompok ahli -terdiri dari psikolog forensik, ilmuwan perilaku, dan neurosaintis- menghadirkan dan mewawancarai sejumlah kriminal di sebuah laboratorium khusus.

programme.title: Why Do We Hate?
programme.desc: Kebencian adalah emosi yang tidak berguna, namun kekuatan kebencian bisa sangat merusak. Apa yang menyebabkan manusia membenci? Apakah kebencian sesuatu yang kita semua mampu rasakan?

programme.title: Inside The Mind Of A Con Artist - Helmut Kiener
programme.desc: Dijuluki "Mini Madoff," Kiener adalah salah satu penipu terbesar Jerman, menipu ribuan investor swasta dan bank, termasuk Barclays dan JP Morgan, dengan nilai lebih dari $300 juta.

programme.title: What If Fear Didn't Exist?
programme.desc: Rasa takut begitu menguasai kita. Betapa indahnya hidup tanpa rasa takut. Apa yang akan kamu lakukan jika kamu tidak takut? Apakah lebih baik jika tidak ada rasa takut sama sekali?

programme.title: Inside The Mind Of A Con Artist - Christophe Rocancourt
programme.desc: Christophe Rocancourt adalah seorang penipu dan penipu Prancis yang menipu orang-orang kaya dan berkuasa dengan berpura-pura sebagai bangsawan Prancis, pewaris keluarga Rockefeller, atau sebagai pangeran Rusia.

programme.title: Do We All Hear the Same Things?
programme.desc: Hidup punya soundtrack uniknya sendiri. Di mana pun kita berada atau apa yang kita lakukan, kita dikelilingi oleh suara. Tapi saat kita mendengar suara, apakah suara-suara itu terdengar sama bagi kita masing-masing?

programme.title: Will We Stop Flying?
programme.desc: Perjalanan udara adalah pembunuh iklim. Tapi tanpa penerbangan, rantai pasokan akan terputus. Jika kita ingin terus terbang, saatnya transformasi energi revolusioner.

programme.title: Inside The Mind Of A Con Artist - Matthew Cox
programme.desc: Mengikuti sebuah eksperimen unik di mana sekelompok ahli -terdiri dari psikolog forensik, ilmuwan perilaku, dan neurosaintis- menghadirkan dan mewawancarai sejumlah kriminal di sebuah laboratorium khusus.

programme.title: Will We Love Robots?
programme.desc: Dengan A.I., robot bisa mengenali kita, mengemudikan mobil, melakukan operasi, dan bermain catur. Tapi apakah robot punya perasaan? Apakah kita akan pernah mencintai mereka, dan bisakah mereka mencintai kita kembali?

programme.title: Should We Dream More?
programme.desc: Enam tahun hidup kita dihabiskan untuk bermimpi. Bagaimana jika kita bisa mengambil ide-ide brilian dari mimpi kita dan mengubahnya menjadi kenyataan? Bagaimana kita bisa memberi mimpi kita makna lebih dalam?

programme.title: No Visitors
programme.desc: Lewis Cutterman, dokter bedah terhormat, menyimpan rahasia kelam. Keluarganya membius tamu lalu memakan tubuhnya sedikit demi sedikit untuk memperdagangkan organ demi pasien kaya.

programme.title: Among The Shadows
programme.desc: Seorang detektif swasta harus mengungkap pembunuhan pamannya sambil menjaga rahasia bahwa dia adalah keturunan manusia serigala.

programme.title: Bad Men Must Bleed
programme.desc: Film ini mengikuti perjalanan seorang pria yang memburu geng saudaranya di seluruh wilayah barat Amerika untuk menghentikan aksi brutal mereka.

programme.title: Bad Men Must Bleed
programme.desc: Film ini mengikuti perjalanan seorang pria yang memburu geng saudaranya di seluruh wilayah barat Amerika untuk menghentikan aksi brutal mereka.

programme.title: Gunfight At Dry River
programme.desc: Perbatasan AS-Meksiko pada tahun 1888. Di Dry River, sebuah kota gurun yang dilanda kekeringan, janji emas akan membawa harapan, cinta, dan kematian dalam ukuran yang sama.

programme.title: While We Sleep
programme.desc: Setelah mengamati hasil pemindaian CAT abnormal yang sangat familiar pada seorang gadis berusia 13 tahun, ahli radiologi Nina Evanko berjuang untuk menemukan sumber gangguan tidur yang dialami gadis muda itu. Apa yang ia temukan lebih gelap dan aneh dari yang dapat ia bayangkan.

programme.title: Born To Dance
programme.desc: Tu adalah seorang pemuda ambisius yang bermimpi menjadi penari hip-hop profesional. Kala sang ayah melarangnya, ia malah memutuskan untuk menjadikan tarian sebagai jalan hidupnya.

programme.title: The Devil's Trap
programme.desc: Seorang pendeta melakukan perjalanan untuk menyelidiki seorang tukang giling yang dicurigai bekerja sama dengan iblis.

programme.title: Old Henry
programme.desc: Seorang petani menampung seorang pria yang terluka dengan tas berisi uang tunai. Ketika sekelompok orang datang untuk mengambil uang itu, dia harus memutuskan siapa yang bisa dipercaya. Saat mempertahankan diri dari pengepungan, dia mengungkapkan bakatnya sebagai penembak jitu yang membuat identitas aslinya dipertanyakan.

programme.title: Exists
programme.desc: Sekelompok teman menjalajahi kawasan hutan terpencil di Texas untuk bersenang-senang di akhir pekan, namun mereka dibuntuti oleh Bigfoot.

programme.title: Operation Seawolf
programme.desc: Angkatan Laut Jerman dan kapal-kapal U-Boat yang tersisa bergabung untuk satu misi terakhir guna menyerang Amerika Serikat.

programme.title: A Tale Of Two Guns
programme.desc: Di Barat yang tak ada aturan hukum, The Cowboys, kakak-beradik pembunuh dan pencuri nan terkenal, menguasai wilayah tersebut dengan tinju brutal dan senjata api. Namun, takdir akhirnya datang menghampiri mereka.

programme.title: Zombieland: Double Tap (Galaxy Premium)
programme.desc: Columbus, Tallahassee, Wichita, dan Little Rock pindah ke jantung Amerika saat mereka menghadapi segerombolan zombie yang berevolusi, sesama penyintas, dan kekacauan dalam keluarga mereka.

programme.title: Superbad
programme.desc: Dua siswa SMA harus mengatasi kegelisahan mereka akan perpisahan setelah rencana mereka untuk mengadakan sebuah pesta berakhir berantakan.

programme.title: The Rundown
programme.desc: Seorang calon koki yang tangguh disewa untuk membawa pulang putra seorang mafia dari Amazon, tetapi malah terlibat dalam perjuangan melawan penguasa kota yang menindas dan pencarian harta karun legendaris.

programme.title: The Dark Tower
programme.desc: Seorang bocah yang dihantui oleh bayangan menara kegelapan dari dunia paralel bekerja sama dengan penjaga menara untuk mencegah sesosok mahluk jahat yang ingin menghancurkan menara tersebut dan membuka gerbang neraka.

programme.title: I Spy
programme.desc: Seorang atlet profesional harus membantu agen pemerintah AS menemukan jet yang hilang.

programme.title: Alpha
programme.desc: Di jaman prasejarah, seorang pemuda berusaha kembali ke rumahnya setelah terpisah dari sukunya saat berburu banteng. Ia bertemu dengan serigala yang juga terpisah dari kawanannya, dan memulai persahabatan nan hangat.

programme.title: Alpha
programme.desc: Di jaman prasejarah, seorang pemuda berusaha kembali ke rumahnya setelah terpisah dari sukunya saat berburu banteng. Ia bertemu dengan serigala yang juga terpisah dari kawanannya, dan memulai persahabatan nan hangat.

programme.title: The Other Guys
programme.desc: Dua detektif mendapat kesempatan untuk beraksi seperti polisi terkenal yang selalu mereka kagumi, tetapi situasi tidak selalu berjalan seperti yang direncanakan.

programme.title: Priest
programme.desc: Seorang pendeta pejuang melanggar hukum gereja untuk melacak sekelompok vampir yang telah menculik keponakannya.

programme.title: Punisher: War Zone
programme.desc: Frank Castle, yang dikenal sebagai Punisher, tanpa ampun membasmi kejahatan terorganisir, tetapi hal itu justru memicu perang yang lebih besar.

programme.title: The One
programme.desc: Seorang agen ditugasi mengamati sejumlah dunia alternatif kala sosok lain dirinya nan jahat mulai membunuh beberapa duplikat dirinya yang lain agar menjadi Sang Tunggal. Bentrokan antardunia paralel pun terjadi.

programme.title: Stealth
programme.desc: Terlindung dalam program militer yang sangat rahasia, tiga pilot berjuang untuk mengendalikan program kecerdasan buatan sebelum memulai perang dunia berikutnya.

programme.title: Salt (Galaxy Premium)
programme.desc: Kehidupan agen CIA, Evelyn Salt, berubah drastis ketika ia dituduh merencanakan pembunuhan Presiden Rusia. Demi membuktikan bahwa dirinya tidak bersalah, Salt melarikan diri dan memulai perjalanan berbahaya untuk mengungkap kebenaran.

programme.title: Black Hawk Down (Galaxy Premium)
programme.desc: Kisah tentang seratus enam puluh tentara elit AS yang diterjunkan ke Mogadishu pada Oktober 1993 untuk menangkap dua letnan utama seorang panglima perang pemberontak, tetapi malah mendapati diri mereka terlibat dalam pertempuran sengit dengan pasukan besar Somalia yang bersenjata lengkap.

programme.title: Envy
programme.desc: Seorang pria menjadi semakin iri terhadap kesuksesan yang baru diraih temannya.

programme.title: Zombieland
programme.desc: Seorang siswa pemalu, seorang pria bersenjata dan sepasang kakak-beradik bekerja sama dalam melawan zombie yang mewabah di Amerika.

programme.title: Fresh Off The Sea S3, Ep 11
programme.desc: Fresh off the Sea kembali dengan musim ketiganya, menghadirkan kehidupan nyata bertema "dari laut ke meja makan" dengan tantangan yang lebih berat dan sajian musiman yang semakin beragam. Yum Jung Ah, Kim Sun Young, Kang You Seok, dan Roh Yoon Seo menjelajahi laut, ladang, serta sungai untuk memanen bahan-bahan segar sesuai musim, lalu mengolah hasil kerja keras mereka menjadi hidangan lezat.

programme.title: New World
programme.desc: Kang, kepala kepolisian, memerintahkan polisi yang menyamar, Ja-Seoung, untuk berpartisipasi dalam proyek Dunia Baru. Namun, Ja-Seoung harus memilih antara mengikuti perintah Kang atau tetap setia kepada Jeong Cheong.

programme.title: Kingmaker
programme.desc: Film ini didasarkan pada kisah anekdotal tentang hubungan kerja antara Kim Dae-jung dan ahli strategi politiknya, Uhm Chang-rok. Seo Chang-dae adalah seorang ahli strategi politik yang mengutamakan kemenangan di atas segalanya, sedangkan Kim Woon-beom adalah seorang politisi dengan ambisi menjadi presiden terkemuka. Namun, konflik internal dalam kampanye muncul saat Seo Chang Dae mendesak Kim Woon Bum untuk melakukan beberapa taktik curang.

programme.title: LEGO Marvel Super Heroes: Maximum Overload
programme.desc: When Jestro the Jester finds the Book of Monsters, chaos breaks loose in the Kingdom of Knighton. Can the newly graduated Knights from the Knights’ Academy save the kingdom? It’s final graduation fighting exams for the latest Knights from Knights’ Academy. All our new Knights demonstrate their prowess: CLAY, AARON, AXL and LANCE. PRINCESS MACY get to join them, but her father doesn’t want her to graduate. As part of the entertainment, MERLOK does an amazing magic trick. His act is followed by…JESTRO, the King’s Jester. He’s terrible (and he should know to never follow a better act.) Everyone laughed because he's a real joke....a total failure. While Jestro roams the halls fo the King's Castle, forlorn, he hears the BOOK OF MONSTERS calling to him from Merlok's library. The book talks Jestro into gathering as many books of spells as he can carry, but they're interrupted by...Clay! As Jestro quickly pages through the Book of Monsters to attack Clay, Merlok arrives. There's a battle in the library between Jestro and Merlok. Finally, the wizard summons up his most powerful spell in self-defence. BOOM! There's a big, magical explosion and when Clay forces his way back into the library, Merlok, Jestro and the magic books are...GONE!

PRINCESS MACY get to join them, but her father doesn’t want her to graduate. As part of the entertainment, MERLOK does an amazing magic trick. His act is followed by…JESTRO, the King’s Jester. He’s terrible (and he should know to never follow a better act.) Everyone laughed because he's a real joke....a total failure. While Jestro roams the halls fo the King's Castle, forlorn, he hears the BOOK OF MONSTERS calling to him from Merlok's library. The book talks Jestro into gathering as many books of spells as he can carry, but they're interrupted by...Clay! As Jestro quickly pages through the Book of Monsters to attack Clay, Merlok arrives. There's a battle in the library between Jestro and Merlok. Finally, the wizard summons up his most powerful spell in self-defence. BOOM! There's a big, magical explosion and when Clay forces his way back into the library, Merlok, Jestro and the magic books are...GONE!

programme.title: Dead Awake
programme.desc: Kate Bowman is a by-the-books social worker who is investigating a series of mysterious deaths. Each victim suffered from sleep paralysis, a frightening ailment that immobilizes its victims as they dream. Kate is approached by an unorthodox doctor who warns of an evil entity that haunts people in their sleep. She brushes aside his admonition, but when a terrifying entity begins to haunt Kate's friends and loved ones, she must fight to stay awake to stop the nightmare she's unleashed.

programme.title: Hollow Creek
programme.desc: Trying to find inspiration for his next horror novel, Blake retreats to the Appalachian Mountains with his mistress, Angelica. When she disappears, Blake becomes a prime suspect.

programme.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: The Brain That Wouldn't Die
programme.desc: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark. Elvira prepares to compete on a game show while hosting "The Brain That Wouldn't Die."

programme.title: Eye See You
programme.desc: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

programme.title: Crocodile
programme.desc: A group of friends goes on a boat trip - but their joyful weekend turns into horror when a giant killer crocodile, searching for its stolen eggs, picks off anyone who gets in its way.

programme.title: Maneater
programme.desc: Townspeople must venture deep into the woods to save their isolated town from an escaped Bengal tiger.

programme.title: Dominion: Prequel To The Exorcist [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Haunted by terrible acts the Nazis forced him to participate in, the disenchanted Father Lankester Merrin focuses his energies on helping with an archaeological dig in the northern part of Kenya. There, the crew uncovers a church that predates Christian missions into the area, but the discovery also causes strange events to start occurring -- including physical changes to a young, disabled boy, whom Merrin grows to suspect has been possessed by a demon.

programme.title: Black Christmas [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: As winter break begins, a group of sorority sisters, including Jess (Olivia Hussey) and the often inebriated Barb (Margot Kidder), begin to receive anonymous, lascivious phone calls. Initially, Barb eggs the caller on, but stops when he responds threateningly. Soon, Barb's friend Clare (Lynne Griffin) goes missing from the sorority house, and a local adolescent girl is murdered, leading the girls to suspect a serial killer is on the loose. But no one realizes just how near the culprit is.

programme.title: The Vault
programme.desc: Some curious students visit an abandoned school and learn its shameful history isn't fully in the past. Their trip turns into a fight for survival.

programme.title: An American Werewolf in Paris
programme.desc: A group of carousing American tourists is taking in the cultural landmarks of Paris when a chance encounter results in sightseer Andy McDermott (Tom Everett Scott) saving the life of Parisian Serafine Pigot (Julie Delpy). While on a date at a nightclub with Serafine, Andy is suddenly attacked and bitten by a werewolf. The next day he discovers that Serafine is also a lycanthrope, and that he is beginning his own grueling, hirsute transformation into one of the fanged beasts.

programme.title: The Bone Snatcher
programme.desc: When four jewel hunters are found dead in the desert with the flesh stripped from their bodies, it's up to Dr. Zack Straker to find out what's gone wrong.

programme.title: Prom Night
programme.desc: This slasher movie follows a relentless killer who is out to avenge the death of a young girl who died after being bullied and teased by four of her classmates. Now high-school students, the guilt-ridden kids have kept their involvement a secret, but when they start being murdered, one by one, it's clear that someone knows the truth. Also coping with the past are members of the dead girl's family, most notably her prom-queen sister, Kim Hammond.

programme.title: Maniac Cop 2
programme.desc: Renegade police officer Matthew Cordell (Robert Z'Dar) once roamed the streets of New York City unleashing his murderous brand of vigilante justice upon its denizens before being struck down by good cop Jack Forrest (Bruce Campbell). Now, Forrest is eager to move on from those heinous events, but he is stopped short when a familiar killing spree begins. Though thought dead and gone, Cordell is back from the grave and ready to wreak his merciless havoc once more.

programme.title: Charlie's Farm
programme.desc: Four friends go into Australia's outback to explore the site where a violent family met its end at the hands of an angry mob. Despite all warnings, they persist in their terrifying adventure.

programme.title: Maniac Cop 3: Badge of Silence
programme.desc: Cop Katie Sullivan (Gretchen Becker) shoots two crooks who are robbing a store, and though she's also wounded in the process, reporters cast her as a trigger-happy rogue. Devious police department bosses, hoping to get rid of a public relations problem, plan to kill Sullivan. But Matt Cordell (Robert Z'Dar), a dead cop who's just been resurrected, takes a liking to Sullivan and is determined to mow down her enemies before a police detective, Sean McKinney (Robert Davi), can stop him.

programme.title: Eraserhead [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Henry (John Nance) resides alone in a bleak apartment surrounded by industrial gloom. When he discovers that an earlier fling with Mary X (Charlotte Stewart) left her pregnant, he marries the expectant mother and has her move in with him. Things take a decidedly strange turn when the couple's baby turns out to be a bizarre lizard-like creature that won't stop wailing. Other characters, including a disfigured lady who lives inside a radiator, inhabit the building and add to Henry's troubles.

programme.title: Chopping Mall [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Eight teenagers are trapped after hours in a high-tech shopping mall and pursued by three murderous security robots out of control.

programme.title: Swarmed
programme.desc: The residents of a small town find themselves battling a swarm of hornets that have been sprayed by a super pesticide.

programme.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: Manos: The Hands Of Fate
programme.desc: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark. Elvira tries to elevate the material by hosting Manos as if it were an episode of Masterpiece Theater.

programme.title: Long Weekend
programme.desc: Peter (John Hargreaves) and Marcia (Briony Behets), a bitter married couple teetering on the edge of divorce, take a camping trip to heal the rift between them. As the weekend progresses, the selfish pair engage in reckless behavior that demonstrates an increasing disrespect for their natural surroundings. When Peter and Marcia become the targets of a series of inexplicable animal attacks, it becomes clear that an angry Mother Nature has come to exact her revenge.

programme.title: Fade To Black [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A shy, lonely film buff embarks on a killing spree against those who browbeat and betray him, all the while stalking his idol, a Marilyn Monroe lookalike.

programme.title: Living Dark: The Story of Ted the Caver
programme.desc: Two estranged brothers become obsessed with gaining access to an unexplored cave, despite the horrors they encounter during their excavation.

programme.title: Spiders 2
programme.desc: Alexandra (Stephanie Niznik) and Jason (Greg Cromer) are a married couple whose yacht fails to withstand a storm at sea. They're saved from the stormy waters by Capt. Bigelow (Daniel Quinn) and his crew, who man a cargo ship. Jason is heavily drugged by the ship's doctor, Gerbac (Richard Moll), and realizes something is amiss when he comes across corpses. Meanwhile, Gerbac is working on a dangerous scientific experiment using spider eggs, which he hopes to implant in Jason's body.

programme.title: Hush (2016) [B&W Shush Cut] [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A deaf and mute writer who retreated into the woods to live a solitary life must fight for her life in silence when a masked killer appears at her window.

programme.title: A Fantastic Fear Of Everything [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A crime novelist whose research on Victorian serial killers has turned him into a paranoid wreck must confront his worst fears when a film executive takes a sudden interest in his movie script.

programme.title: Megaboa
programme.desc: On a trip to Colombia, a group of college students heads into the rainforest to look for cave drawings. Instead, they find a 50-foot boa constrictor.

programme.title: The Exorcist III: Legion (Director's Cut) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Police Lt. Kinderman (George C. Scott) notices similarities between his current murder investigation and the methods used by the Gemini killer (Brad Dourif) who was executed 15 years before. He soon discovers a hospitalized mental patient (Jason Miller) claiming to be the dead serial killer, but who looks uncannily like a priest Kinderman knew who died during an exorcism. As more bodies are found, Kinderman looks for connections between the two supposedly dead men.

programme.title: 10 Items or Less
programme.desc: An actor (Morgan Freeman) who is considering the role of a supermarket manager arrives at a grocery store on the outskirts of Los Angeles to do some field research. He subsequently becomes stranded, without a car or cell phone, and accepts a ride home with Scarlet (Paz Vega), a cashier who is about to interview for a new job. The actor rediscovers the essence of his craft while helping Scarlet gain the confidence she needs to change her life.

programme.title: The Rage: Carrie 2
programme.desc: When her closest friend commits suicide after being manipulated by the popular crowd, quiet and bookish Rachel Lang (Emily Bergl) decides to get back at the guilty parties. Although Rachel falls for sensitive football player Jesse Ryan (Jason London), she remains determined to punish his callous friends. When Rachel discovers that she has superhuman abilities, it ups the stakes for her revenge, echoing a supernatural incident that occurred decades before.

programme.title: Ginger Snaps
programme.desc: The story of two outcast sisters, Ginger (Katharine Isabelle) and Brigitte (Emily Perkins), in the mindless suburban town of Bailey Downs. On the night of Ginger's first period, she is savagely attacked by a wild creature. Ginger's wounds miraculously heal, but something is not quite right. Now Brigitte must save her sister and save herself.

programme.title: Ginger Snaps II: Unleashed
programme.desc: A patient (Tatiana Maslany) at a rehabilitation center tries to prevent a young woman (Emily Perkins) from transforming into a werewolf.

programme.title: Ginger Snaps Back: The Beginning
programme.desc: In early 19th-century Canada, orphaned sisters Ginger (Katharine Isabelle) and Brigitte (Emily Perkins) find themselves lost in a forest while riding on horseback. They're rescued by The Hunter (Nathaniel Arcand), a mysterious Native American who takes them back to Fort Bailey. Something strange has happened there, however. The few settlers who remain are suspicious of outsiders and keep tight-lipped about the situation, but Ginger soon discovers their secret for herself.

After Rachel crashes a car, Lilly decides to haul the girl off to a place to which she vowed never to return: Her own mother's (Jane Fonda) Idaho home. Georgia, the family matriarch, lives by a strict code and expects all under her roof to do the same. Given structure and purpose, Rachel's anger at the world begins to subside.

programme.title: But I'm a Cheerleader
programme.desc: Megan (Natasha Lyonne) considers herself a typical American girl. She excels in school and cheerleading, and she has a handsome football-playing boyfriend, even though she isn't that crazy about him. So she's stunned when her parents decide she's gay and send her to True Directions, a boot camp meant to alter her sexual orientation. While there, Megan meets a rebellious and unashamed teen lesbian, Graham (Clea DuVall). Though Megan still feels confused, she starts to have feelings for Graham.

When Steve's rebellious friend Gavin (Nick Stahl) mysteriously joins their ranks, Steve searches for the truth with fellow misfit Rachel (Katie Holmes).

programme.title: Bourek
programme.desc: Set against the backdrop of economic crisis and bad news, an extravagant international cast of characters meet, fight, and fall in love, while hiding from the end of the world and other calamities on the tiny Greek island of Khronos.

programme.title: Punk Love: Director's Cut
programme.desc: Director's Cut of the multi-award-winning drama Punk Love. Hoping to find a better life, a drug-addicted musician (Chad Lindberg) and his young girlfriend (Emma Bing) embark on a crime spree.

programme.title: Meteor
programme.desc: In this disaster movie, Americans and Soviets must put aside their differences to save civilization from a huge meteor bearing down on the planet. Paul Bradley (Sean Connery) enlists the expertise of fellow scientist Alexei Dubov (Brian Keith), who is joined by his beautiful assistant, Tatiana Donskaya (Natalie Wood). Although Paul and Tatiana are attracted to each other, they wisely focus on taking out the meteor, which may still cause massive destruction even if it is partially damaged.

programme.title: Badland
programme.desc: A young soldier unable to process the horrors of war he experienced in Iraq, returns home only to commit his own horrors.

programme.title: Dog Jack
programme.desc: A 14-year-old slave escapes with his loyal dog to join the Union Army. Hounded by slave trackers, he receives the reluctant help of a minister to reach the army of the North.

programme.title: Runaway Slave
programme.desc: Runaway Slave is a compelling and insightful look on how big government policies have systematically "enslaved" the black population through entitlements and other programs, resulting in a new "welfare state" ...a form of "modern slavery."

programme.title: Insert Coin
programme.desc: The untold story of how Mortal Kombat, NBA Jam, and other arcade classics were created by a ragtag crew in the back of a Chicago factory. Generating billions of dollars, they rode the wave of the booming 90s arcade scene... until a new enemy appears.

programme.title: Fighting the Fire
programme.desc: Brian Cook has been a firefighter for over 15 years, but he is now facing the biggest battle of his life-not the fire in the field, but the fire burning inside.

programme.title: My Own Love Song
programme.desc: A paralyzed singer (Renée Zellweger) and her friend (Forest Whitaker) meet colorful Southerners while taking a road trip to Louisiana.

programme.title: Harrigan
programme.desc: Amongst the Desperation and fear growing in a crime ridden sink estate in northern England, one man becomes involved into saving what little decency and community life exists.

programme.title: Retribution
programme.desc: Dan's mission becomes a race against time to ensure that in Retribution - everybody pays.

programme.title: Ashens and the Polybius Heist
programme.desc: A heist like no other! A motley crew of misfits hunts down an infamous 80's arcade game that can supposedly control people's minds in this chart-topping feel-good British comedy.

programme.title: Xanadu Hellfire
programme.desc: A nine-year-old brings a warrior from the future to the present and an evil follows. An amazingly cool and funny Sci-fi comedy with kids cursing, lasers, time travel, aliens, martial arts, and more!

programme.title: Tomorrow Ever After
programme.desc: Shaina lives 600 years in the future. She's read about poverty, oppression, and violence in history books. When she accidentally time travels to our times, she assumes that everyone is caring and honest as she tries to recruit help to get back home.

programme.title: Code Duello: From The Tithebanner Saga
programme.desc: Following a cataclysmic collision of galaxies, two survivors navigate the strange new world where they find themselves, searching for a place in society to survive and build a new life together.

programme.title: A World Away
programme.desc: Six kids take a trip to the Grand Canyon, but their flight detours into an alternate dimension, and only through growing past distrust will they be able to get back home.

programme.title: Cycles
programme.desc: An apprehensive young man moves into university halls, and the sudden feeling of isolation forces him into an argument with his older brother about identity, love, and the repression of dreams.

programme.title: Boulevard! A Hollywood Story
programme.desc: Dickson Hughes and Richard Stapley, two young songwriters and romantic partners, find themselves caught in movie star Gloria Swanson's web when she hires them to write a musical version of "Sunset Boulevard."

programme.title: Where The Rivers Flow North
programme.desc: Log driver Noel Lord defies power company boss Clayton Farnsworth, who orders Lord and his feisty American Indian mate off their soon-to-be-flooded land. Farnsworth never met a man he couldn't buy - but then, he'd never met Noel Lord.

programme.title: Kung Fu Brother
programme.desc: Three cops and a reporter pursue a murderer who's hellbent on acquiring sacred scrolls. As they chase the murderer far and wide, they must find a way to take him down before he gets his hands on the scrolls.

programme.title: Iceman: Book One
programme.desc: Known as Iceman, a newly retired organized crime fixer is pulled back deeper than ever.

programme.title: All I Want Is You
programme.desc: After holding her man down on a long 4-year bid, Chloe is ready to risk it all when another woman tries to steal her man.

programme.title: Forty Winks
programme.desc: A struggling hypnotist in New York city is blackmailed into being the world's first hypnotist hitman after a mysterious woman finds out his degree is fake.

programme.title: Beautiful Darling
programme.desc: The life and work of Candy Darling, the Andy Warhol superstar.

programme.title: H. H. Holmes: America's First Serial Killer
programme.desc: This chilling documentary follows the macabre exploits of 19th-century serial killer Herman Webster Mudgett, who went by the alias of Dr. Henry Howard Holmes. A remarkably effective con artist and liar, Holmes managed to construct a massive building in Chicago where he operated a labyrinthine hotel for his intended victims. The film features footage of key locations in the life of Holmes, as well as interviews with experts and dramatic reenactments.

programme.title: C.H.U.D.
programme.desc: Photographer George Cooper (John Heard) is documenting the lives of subterranean homeless people, a population that has mysteriously dwindled. After receiving information from a reporter, George becomes aware of a conspiracy theory about cannibalistic monsters lurking in the sewers. He teams up with the reporter, a policeman (Christopher Curry) and a priest (Daniel Stern) to fight two battles: one against the cannibals and the other against a corrupt government official.

programme.title: Red Headed Stranger
programme.desc: The Rev. Shay moves out West to set up his new home in Montana so that he can spread God's word. But when his wife, Raysha, leaves him for another man -- in part because she wants to return to Philadelphia -- the reverend decides to replace his spiritual ways with a gun. After shooting down his wife and her lover, he battles a landowner intent on keeping all the town's water for himself. But his deadly ways make him yearn for a belief in God again.

programme.title: Silver City
programme.desc: A campaign manager hires a private detective (Danny Huston) after a Colorado gubernatorial candidate finds a dead body while fishing.

programme.title: Going All the Way
programme.desc: Korean War--era veterans and ex-classmates "Gunner" Casselman (Ben Affleck) and "Sonny" Burns (Jeremy Davies) reunite upon their return home. Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war.

programme.title: Succubus
programme.desc: A new father struggling with fatigue, emotional insecurities, and a failing marriage joins a dating app, only to swipe right on what may be an inhuman presence.

programme.title: Eraserhead
programme.desc: Henry (John Nance) resides alone in a bleak apartment surrounded by industrial gloom. When he discovers that an earlier fling with Mary X (Charlotte Stewart) left her pregnant, he marries the expectant mother and has her move in with him. Things take a decidedly strange turn when the couple's baby turns out to be a bizarre lizard-like creature that won't stop wailing. Other characters, including a disfigured lady who lives inside a radiator, inhabit the building and add to Henry's troubles.

programme.title: Dead Ringers
programme.desc: Elliot (Jeremy Irons), a successful gynecologist, works at the same practice as his identical twin, Beverly (also Irons). Elliot is attracted to many of his patients and has affairs with them. When he inevitably loses interest, he will give the woman over to Beverly, the meeker of the two, without the woman knowing the difference. Beverly falls hard for one of the patients, Claire (Geneviève Bujold), but when she inadvertently deceives him, he slips into a state of madness.

programme.title: I'm Charlie Walker
programme.desc: In 1971 two oil tankers collide off the coast of San Francisco, spilling millions of gallons of crude oil and creating an environmental disaster. Against all odds, trucking and construction entrepreneur Charlie Walker secures a lucrative contract to clean the coastline. However, he also finds himself fighting institutional racism from the very company that hired him.

programme.title: Nosferatu
programme.desc: Vampire Count Orlok expresses interest in a new residence -- and his new real estate agent Hutter's wife.

programme.title: The Boys From Brazil
programme.desc: Dr. Josef Mengele (Gregory Peck) clones Hitler 95 times, and hopes to raise the resulting boys in Brazil, giving them childhoods identical to Hitler's. His ultimate plan is to create a band of Nazi leaders that can continue where Hitler left off, forming the Fourth Reich. Ezra Lieberman (Laurence Olivier), a Nazi hunter, learns of the plan and is determined to thwart it. When the two meet face-to-face in the home of one of the Hitler clones, it is up to the boy to choose who he will assist.

programme.title: Showdown at the Grand
programme.desc: A movie theater owner must defend his family business from corporate developers alongside a legendary action star as art imitates life in a showdown for the ages.

programme.title: Suburbia
programme.desc: An overwhelming sense of despair impels a teenager to leave his suburban home and join up with a group of punk rockers.

programme.title: City on Fire
programme.desc: An undercover cop (Chow Yun-Fat) infiltrates a gang of jewel thieves, but things go terribly wrong during a heist.

programme.title: Rough Magic
programme.desc: In the midst of a dazzling stage show, magician's assistant Myra Shumway (Bridget Fonda) catches the eye of sleazy industrialist Cliff Wyatt (D.W. Moffett). When Wyatt unwittingly kills Shumway's mentor, a master magician, she flees to Mexico. Furious, Wyatt hires private detective Alex Ross (Russell Crowe) to capture the gorgeous witness to his crime. But, after Ross locates Shumway, he finds himself beguiled by her growing prowess as a magician -- and by the potency of her feminine charms.

programme.title: Slacker
programme.desc: Austin, Texas, is an Eden for the young and unambitious, from the enthusiastically eccentric to the dangerously apathetic. Here, the nobly lazy can eschew responsibility in favor of nursing their esoteric obsessions. The locals include a backseat philosopher (Richard Linklater) who passionately expounds on his dream theories to a seemingly comatose cabbie (Rudy Basquez), a young woman who tries to hawk Madonna's Pap test to anyone who will listen and a kindly old anarchist looking for recruits.

programme.title: Nosferatu the Vampyre
programme.desc: Jonathan Harker is sent away to Count Dracula's castle to sell him a house in Virna, where he lives. But Count Dracula is a vampire, an undead ghoul living off men's blood. Inspired by a photograph of Lucy Harker, Jonathan's wife, Dracula moves to Virna, bringing with him death and plague... An unusually contemplative version of Dracula, in which the vampire bears the cross of not being able to get old and die.

programme.title: Fist of Legend
programme.desc: Chinese martial arts student Chen Zhen is studying in Kyoto, Japan, when he learns his mentor has died in a match against Ryuichi Akutagawa. Returning home to the Japanese-occupied Shanghai of 1937, Chen challenges Ryuichi to a fight and easily defeats him. Concluding his master was set up, Chen has an autopsy performed. Meanwhile, word of his martial arts skill entices new students hoping to study with him, making his teacher's son, Huo Ting-An, jealous.

programme.title: Fast Vengeance
programme.desc: Determined to find those responsible for his brother's death, a man infiltrates the dangerous and high-stakes world of underground motorcycle racing.

programme.title: Take Back
programme.desc: A woman embarks on a vengeful quest to save her kidnapped daughter from a mysterious man from her past.

programme.title: College
programme.desc: Brilliant in his studies and dismissive of athletics, Ronald (Buster Keaton) finishes high school at the top of his class. But in college his uptight attitude doesn't win him any points with his sports-loving classmates, and pretty coed Mary (Anne Cornwall) ignores him in favor of brutish jock Jeff (Harold Goodwin). Hoping to impress Mary, Ronald makes a buffoon of himself at every sport imaginable, usually at Jeff's hand. But Ronald gets a final shot at glory in a big rowing race.

programme.title: Prison on Fire
programme.desc: Yiu (Tony Leung Ka Fai) is a young advertising executive in Hong Kong. One night, defending his father from attack, he accidentally shoves a street thug in front of a bus. Sentenced to three years in prison, Yiu is "fresh meat" for the hardened criminals and triad stooges that run things, and is preyed upon by sadistic guard Scarface (Roy Cheung). The virtuous Ching (Chow Yun-Fat) intervenes, teaching him the ropes of prison life, and a tender friendship develops between the two.

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast
programme.desc: A romance blossoms between the youngest daughter of a merchant who has fallen on hard times and the mysterious beast her father owes a debt to.

programme.title: Skyline
programme.desc: Jarrod (Eric Balfour) and Elaine (Scottie Thompson) take a trip to Southern California to visit his friend, Terry (Donald Faison), for a fun getaway, but it turns into a weekend of terror. During the night a cluster of strange, mesmerizing lights signals the arrival of an alien invasion. As thousands of terrified people are pulled into the maws of giant alien ships, Jarrod and his companions must use every skill they have to survive global genocide.

programme.title: Galaxy of Terror
programme.desc: Neurotic astronauts (Edward Albert, Erin Moran, Ray Walston) face a giant worm and other monsters on a distant planet.

programme.title: Eyes Without a Face
programme.desc: Dr. Génessier (Pierre Brasseur) is riddled with guilt after an accident that he caused disfigures the face of his daughter, the once beautiful Christiane (Edith Scob), who outsiders believe is dead. Dr. Génessier, along with accomplice and laboratory assistant Louise (Alida Valli), kidnaps young women and brings them to the Génessier mansion. After rendering his victims unconscious, Dr. Génessier removes their faces and attempts to graft them on to Christiane's.

programme.title: Heathers
programme.desc: Veronica (Winona Ryder) is part of the most popular clique at her high school, but she disapproves of the other girls' cruel behavior. When Veronica and her new boyfriend, J.D. (Christian Slater), confront clique leader Heather Chandler (Kim Walker) and accidentally poison her, they make it appear a suicide. Soon Veronica realizes that J.D. is intentionally killing students he does not like. She races to stop J.D. while also clashing with the clique's new leader, Heather Duke (Shannen Doherty).

As Behman and five comrades undertake the dangerous journey, they come to realize that the prisoner is no ordinary girl, and evil forces await at the destination.

programme.title: Point Break [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: After a string of bizarre bank robberies in Southern California, with the crooks donning masks of various former presidents, a federal agent, Johnny Utah (Keanu Reeves), infiltrates the suspected gang. But this is no ordinary group of robbers. They're surfers -- led by the charismatic Bodhi (Patrick Swayze) -- who are addicted to the rush of thievery. But when Utah falls in love with a female surfer, Tyler (Lori Petty), who is close to the gang, it complicates his sense of duty.

programme.title: Before The Devil Knows You're Dead [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Andy needs some quick cash gets his younger brother into a scheme to rob their parents' jewelry store.

programme.desc: Sinatra and his adult son, Paul, live on the edge of the law in the Brazilian urban jungle of São Paulo. They make a meager living running a brothel, but what profits they make Paul gambles away. When a customer dies on their premises, leaving behind a suitcase brimming with drugs, Sinatra sees a way to start a new life for his new wife and her young child. But his scheme quickly gets complicated when Paul sees the opportunity to take a calculated risk.

programme.title: Direct Contact

programme.title: Monty Python And The Holy Grail
programme.desc: Grossing the highest box-office of any British film in the US when released in 1975, this "cult classic" comedy from the Monty Python team loosely follows the legend of King Arthur (Graham Chapman), along with his squire (Terry Gilliam) and his Knights of the Round Table (John Cleese, Eric Idle, Terry Jones and Michael Palin), as they embark on a fearless quest in search of the elusive Holy Grail. A hysterical, historical tour-de-force from Terry Gilliam and Terry Jones.

programme.title: 10.5 Apocalypse

With Kyle and Sarah now frightened captives, Kyle knows he must use every negotiating trick in his book, for once Elias and his men get what they want, the Millers will likely be killed.

programme.title: Psycho
programme.desc: Hoping for a fresh start with her broke boyfriend, Marion (Anne Heche) steals a huge sum from her boss and skips town, eventually stopping at a remote motel. There, she's served by the intensely awkward yet docile Norman Bates (Vince Vaughn), whom she often hears arguing with his domineering mother. But later that night, Marion is brutally slain, and Norman finds and hides the body. When a detective and Marion's sister visit the motel to investigate, they uncover shocking truths.

programme.title: Twelve Monkeys
programme.desc: Traveling back in time isn't simple, as James Cole (Bruce Willis) learns the hard way. Imprisoned in the 2030s, James is recruited for a mission that will send him back to the 1990s. Once there, he's supposed to gather information about a nascent plague that's about to exterminate the vast majority of the world's population. But, aside from the manic Jeffrey (Brad Pitt), he gets little in the way of cooperation, not least from medical gatekeepers like Dr. Kathryn Railly (Madeleine Stowe).

programme.title: Altered
programme.desc: Forever damaged by their stint as the scientific subjects of hostile alien creatures, a trio of alien-abduction survivors -- Otis (Michael C. Williams), Duke (Brad William Henke) and Cody (Paul McCarthy-Boyington) -- troll the wooded site of their disappearance, heavily armed, in search of their attackers. After wounding a violent alien in the woods, the three drag its dying body to the home of reclusive fellow abductee Wyatt (Adam Kaufman), barricade themselves in and prepare for the worst.

programme.title: The Forest
programme.desc: When her twin sister disappears in Japan, a young American named Sara becomes determined to find out what happened to her. Sara's investigation leads her to the legendary Aokigahara Forest, located at the base of Mount Fuji. Accompanied by expatriate Aiden, she enters the mysterious wilderness after being warned to "stay on the path." Her investigation plunges her into a dark world where the angry and tormented souls of the dead prey on those who dare to explore the forest.

programme.title: Land of the Dead
programme.desc: In a world where zombies form the majority of the population, the remaining humans build a feudal society away from the undead. Ruthless Paul Kaufman (Dennis Hopper) rules and protects this microcosm but enforces painful class distinctions. Second-in-command Cholo DeMora (John Leguizamo) attempts to lead a secret rebellion against Kaufman's tyranny, but when the zombies begin to evolve, the survivors must discover a way to protect themselves from a zombie horde that can learn and adapt.

programme.title: Werewolf: The Beast Among Us
programme.desc: A mysterious creature terrorizes a village, and Daniel teams up with werewolf hunters to track down the vicious beast. As villagers are attacked one by one and, themselves, turned into beasts, Daniel fears the foe is someone close to them all.

programme.title: Tremors 4: The Legend Begins
programme.desc: Prim East Coast dandy Hiram Gummer (Michael Gross) arrives in the town of Rejection, Nev., to investigate a series of strange deaths at the silver mine he owns. He receives help from local innkeeper Christine Lord (Sara Botsford) and miner Juan Pedilla (Brent Roam). But, when it turns out that gigantic killer worms that burrow underground are responsible for the miners' deaths, Hiram decides he'd better call in expert gunslinger Black Hand Kelly (Billy Drago) to save the day.

programme.title: Tremors 5: Bloodlines
programme.desc: Survivalist Burt Gummer (Michael Gross) and his new sidekick Travis (Jamie Kennedy) are hired to track down an ass-blaster terrorizing South Africa. As they engage in battles with the aggressive creatures, they discover an even more lethal creature.

programme.title: Tremors: Shrieker Island
programme.desc: Burt Gummer must save the day when a wealthy playboy unleashes a gigantic, carnivorous worm and other monsters on a tropical island.

programme.title: Serenity
programme.desc: In this continuation of the television series "Firefly," a group of rebels travels the outskirts of space aboard their ship, Serenity, outside the reach of the Alliance, a sinister regime that controls most of the universe. After the crew takes in Simon (Sean Maher) and his psychic sister, River (Summer Glau), whom he has just rescued from Alliance forces, they find themselves being pursued by the Operative (Chiwetel Ejiofor), an Alliance agent who will stop at nothing to find them.

programme.title: Pitch Black
programme.desc: When their ship crashes on an unexplored planet, the survivors of the crash soon discover that this planet that is normally always day is going to soon be in a state of eclipse that will bring out deadly nocturnal creatures. Will a prison convict (Vin Diesel) being transported on the ship end up being the one man who can lead the survivors off the planet?

programme.title: Oblivion
programme.desc: In the year 2077, Jack Harper works as a security repairman on an Earth left empty and devastated after a war with aliens. Jack has two weeks left before his mission ends, and he joins his fellow survivors on a faraway colony. However, Jack's concept of reality comes crashing down after he rescues a beautiful stranger from a downed spacecraft. The woman's arrival triggers a chain of events that culminates in Jack's nearly single-handed battle to save mankind.

programme.title: The Mummy
programme.desc: Nick Morton is a soldier of fortune who plunders ancient sites for timeless artifacts and sells them to the highest bidder. When Nick and his partner come under attack in the Middle East, the ensuing battle accidentally unearths Ahmanet, a betrayed Egyptian princess who was entombed under the desert for thousands of years. With her powers constantly evolving, Morton must now stop the resurrected monster as she embarks on a furious rampage through the streets of London.

programme.title: The Scorpion King 2: Rise of a Warrior
programme.desc: After a swarm of enchanted scorpions kills his father, Mathayus (Michael Copon) flees and vows to even the score with ruthless sorcerer Sargon (Randy Couture). Upon returning home after years of combat training, Mathayus finds that Sargon has seized the crown and protected himself with a powerful spell. To retrieve the only weapon capable of destroying the tyrant -- a mystical sword -- Mathayus and lady warrior Layla (Karen David) set off for a labyrinth guarded by a deadly Minotaur.

programme.title: The Scorpion King 4: Quest for Power
programme.desc: Mathayus is framed for the murder of the king of Norvania, and he and his allies have to stop the evil heir from finding a mythical power.

programme.title: Hulk
programme.desc: Eric Bana ("Black Hawk Down") stars as scientist Bruce Banner, whose inner demons transform him in the aftermath of a catastrophic experiment; Jennifer Connelly portrays Betty Ross, whose scientific genius unwittingly helps unleash the Hulk; Nick Nolte plays Banner's brilliant father, who passes on a tragic legacy to his son; and Sam Elliott portrays the commander of a top-secret military research center.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop
programme.desc: In this action-comedy, unusual circumstances find big, brawny cop John Kimble (Arnold Schwarzenegger) posing as a kindergarten teacher in order to apprehend major drug lord Cullen Crisp (Richard Tyson), as well as his ruthless accomplice and mother, Eleanor (Carroll Baker). While pretending to be a kid-friendly instructor, Kimble falls for pretty fellow teacher Joyce Palmieri (Penelope Ann Miller) as he battles both unruly children and dangerous bad guys.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop 2
programme.desc: A gruff FBI agent goes undercover as a kindergarten teacher. He's there to recover stolen data, but first he'll have to learn to survive in the politically correct world of elementary education.

programme.title: Thunderbirds
programme.desc: Former astronaut Jeff Tracy (Bill Paxton) runs International Rescue, a top-secret heroic organization, from his headquarters on Tracy Island. The island also houses the futuristic vehicles created by Ray "Brains" Hackenbacker (Anthony Edwards). But while Jeff is on a mission in space, his nemesis, The Hood (Ben Kingsley), invades Tracy Island. The Hood plots to use the island's technology for evil, and only Jeff's son, Alan (Brady Corbet), can stop him.

programme.title: Undercover Brother
programme.desc: Blasted from the past and ready to take care of business, "Undercover Brother" is recruited to infiltrate a sinister underground movement headed by The Man. Partnered with the sassy, stunning Sistah Girl, our hero must first undergo the ultimate attitude adjustment and trade in his 'fro and platforms for tennis sweaters and penny loafers. Once the transformation is complete, he's ready to take on the evil perpetrators of Operation Whitewash.

programme.title: Alpha Dog
programme.desc: Teenage dealer Johnny Truelove (Emile Hirsch) and his friends kidnap the impressionable younger brother (Anton Yelchin) of a junkie (Ben Foster) who refuses to pay his drug debt. Things change unexpectedly when Frankie (Justin Timberlake), one of Johnny's pals, befriends the youth.

programme.title: Chinese Zodiac
programme.desc: A treasure hunter (Jackie Chan) and his team set out on a global quest to find a set of Chinese zodiac bronze heads that were stolen from a Beijing palace in the 19th century.

programme.title: Trespass
programme.desc: Firefighters Vince (Bill Paxton) and Don (William Sadler) venture into gang-infested territory to find gold that's been hidden inside an abandoned building. But when they witness a murder, they become the targets of crime lord King James (Ice-T) and his underling Savon (Ice Cube). Fortunately, the treasure hunters have kidnapped a bargaining chip: King James' half-brother, Lucky (Devoreaux White). But this might not be enough to get them -- and their gold -- out of the building intact.

programme.title: Smokin' Aces
programme.desc: Sleazy entertainer Buddy "Aces" Israel incurs the wrath of crime boss Primo Sparazza when he agrees to testify against the Las Vegas mob. Two FBI agents have the difficult task of protecting him from a motley assortment of bounty hunters, hit men and nefarious vixens who are converging on his Lake Tahoe encampment to rub him out and collect a hefty reward.

programme.title: The Frighteners
programme.desc: Once an architect, Frank Bannister (Michael J. Fox) now passes himself off as an exorcist of evil spirits. To bolster his facade, he claims his "special" gift is the result of a car accident that killed his wife. But what he does not count on is more people dying in the small town where he lives. As he tries to piece together the supernatural mystery of these killings, he falls in love with the wife (Trini Alvarado) of one of the victims and deals with a crazy FBI agent (Jeffrey Combs).

programme.title: The Divergent Series: Allegiant
programme.desc: Tris escapes with Four to journey beyond the wall that encloses Chicago. For the first time, they leave the only city and family they have ever known to find a peaceful solution. Once outside, they learn shocking new truths that render old discoveries meaningless. As the ruthless battle threatens humanity, Tris and Four quickly decide who to trust to survive. Tris must ultimately make difficult choices about courage, allegiance, sacrifice and love.

programme.title: Divergent
programme.desc: Tris Prior lives in a futuristic world in which society is divided into five factions. As each person enters adulthood, he or she must choose a faction and commit to it for life. Tris chooses Dauntless -- those who pursue bravery above all else. However, her initiation leads to the discovery that she is a Divergent and will never be able to fit into just one faction. Warned that she must conceal her status, Tris uncovers a looming war which threatens everyone she loves.

programme.title: The Divergent Series: Insurgent
programme.desc: Now on the run from Jeanine and the rest of the power-hungry Erudites, Tris and Four search for allies and answers in the ruins of Chicago. They must find out what Tris' family sacrificed their lives to protect and why the Erudites will do anything to stop them. Side by side, Tris and Four face one seemingly insurmountable challenge after another, as they unravel the secrets of the past and -- ultimately -- the future of their world.

Chosen by destiny, our heroes quickly discover they are the only ones who can save the planet. But to do so, they will have to overcome their real-life issues and, before it's too late, band together as the Power Rangers.

programme.title: Borderlands
programme.desc: Returning to her home planet Pandora, an infamous bounty hunter forms an unexpected alliance with a ragtag team of misfits. Together, they battle alien monsters and dangerous bandits to uncover one of Pandora's most explosive secrets.

programme.desc: An agoraphobic gamer agrees to test new equipment that uses AI to interpret the electrical activity of her brain. Soon, the line between reality and her subconscious starts to blur as she wonders if the device is serving a sinister force.

programme.desc: When a copycat murderer strikes, Detectives Jake Doyle and Mary Kelly seek help from an incarcerated serial killer called the Artist. As Mary delves deep into the Artist's brilliant but twisted psyche, she and Jake get lured into a diabolical game of cat and mouse, racing against time to stay one step ahead of both criminals.

programme.desc: Stripped of their possessions, six strangers wake up in a remote, endless cornfield with six items -- a gun with a single bullet, matches, a lantern, a knife, a compass and a flask of water. As mysterious sirens blare in the distance and traps appear at every turn, they soon realize they're in a mysterious cat-and-mouse game with an unseen evil, and survival depends upon solving a diabolical and deadly puzzle.

programme.title: Not to Forget

programme.title: My Dog The Space Traveller

programme.title: Mail Order Monster

programme.title: Arthur: I Wanna Hold Your Hand/Whistling in the Wind

programme.sub-title: I Wanna Hold Your Hand/Whistling in the Wind

programme.title: Arthur: The Boy With His Head In The Clouds/More!

He's just…about…to get the book when…the impatient Magmar attacks! Everyone thinks it's part of the big show! “Ned Knightly, Knight of Knighton, Issue #1” is tossed from person-to-person-to-person in the melee. The Knights must do something, but they're too far away from the Fortrex to download any NEXO-Power. Robin pulls up in his Minitrex they can use it to get NEXO-Power! programme.title: The Oni And The Dragon
programme.desc: While Princess Harumi learns to adjust to the life of a Ninja, Lloyd and Jay search for answers about the Oni Masks at Mystake's Tea house, while Cole and Zane attempt to infiltrate the Sons of Garmadon biker gang. Remembering that Lloyd managed to arrest one of the gang members at Borg Tower, the Ninja decide to interrogate him to ascertain the location of the third Oni Mask. In order to get him to talk, however, Cole suggests they visit MYSTAKE'S TEA HOUSE to obtain some "truth tea." The truth-tea backfires spectacularly when Cole accidentally switches cups and drinks the tea himself. Zane is able to salvage the situation, however, and obtains a lead. He learns that the Sons of Garmadon frequent a karaoke bar called LAUGHY'S. Zane and Cole don disguises to infiltrate the bar. Cole assumes the alter ego “Rocky Dangerbuff," while Zane adopts the subtler moniker "Snake Jaguar." In order to earn the gang's trust, Cole performs a karaoke routine that is a smash success. Unfortunately, during the routine, his disguise comes loose and he is exposed as a ninja. The Sons of Garmadon attack him, and Zane (who is still in disguise) is unable to intervene. Cole is taken prisoner while Zane is invited back to the Sons of Garmadon's secret base.

programme.title: The Pranks
programme.desc: The friends are using their talents to pull a prank on Olivia. But who gets the last laugh?Stephanie finds the perfect front page story for the school paper! It's almost too good to be true. Emma and Andrea go undercover to solve the mystery of the two Jacobs.

programme.title: Getting Out the Vote
programme.desc: It's Stephanie vs. Tanya for Heartlake High Class President. But when Tanya resorts to dirty tricks, Stephanie decides to give her a taste of her own medicine. Elect Tanya as Heartlake High Class President?! "NOOOOOOOO!!!!" Not if Friends Stephanie, Emma, Olivia, Mia and Andrea can help it. The Friends are there to help their pal Matthew defeat Tanya -- even when Emma gets carried off by "Vote For Matthew" balloons! But Tanya figures since "Daddy" is now the Mayor of Heartlake City, she doesn't have to play by the rules. When she sneakily sabotages Matthew's campaign, it's time for a determined Stephanie to take his place as candidate. With the help of her friends, Stephanie is set on running a clean campaign -- that is, until Tanya resorts to more dirty tricks, and Stephanie decides to give Tanya a taste of her own medicine.
